sections.history: Tirupperuvelur, at Manakkal Ayyampettai about 10 km from Tiruvarur and 30 km from Kumbakonam, is a Paadal Petra Sthalam, hymned in the Tevaram by Tirugnana Sambandar and Appar (Tirunavukkarasar). Its historical name is Tirupperuvelur; it stands among the Shiva shrines of the Tiruvarur delta, and the stone temple is of the Chola period and later.
sections.architecture: A Dravidian delta temple, the shrine enshrines Abhimukteswarar — also Avimukteswarar, Priyanathar — in the sanctum, with the goddess Baagampriyal (also named Niraikonda Nayaki) in her own shrine, a Nandi and the parivara devatas about the prakara. The walled courtyard and modest gopuram keep the form of the Shiva temples of the Tiruvarur country.
sections.legends: Shiva is worshipped here as Abhimukteswarar — Avimukteswarar, 'the never-forsaking lord' — and as Priyanathar, 'the beloved lord'; the goddess is Baagampriyal, who shares the lord's half. As with many delta shrines, the fuller sthala purana survives chiefly in local tradition and the Tevaram verses of Sambandar and Appar.
sections.festivals: The temple observes Maha Shivaratri in Masi (February–March), Navaratri in Purattasi (September–October) and the Mondays of Karthikai, with Pradosha worship, at the quiet scale of a village shrine. Pilgrims of the Tiruvarur delta include Tirupperuvelur among their stops.
sections.experience: At Tirupperuvelur the pilgrim comes to a quiet shrine of the never-forsaking lord. Before Abhimukteswarar and Baagampriyal, in the green Tiruvarur country, the visitor finds the unhurried grace of a Tevaram temple of the delta.

visit.timings: Typically open from early morning to midday and again from late afternoon into the evening; confirm timings locally, especially on festival days.
visit.dressCode: Modest traditional attire is expected, with shoulders and knees covered; footwear is left at the entrance.
visit.photography: Photography is generally allowed in the outer corridors but not inside the sanctum; ask temple staff before photographing rituals.
visit.gettingThere: Tirupperuvelur is at Manakkal Ayyampettai, about 10 km from Tiruvarur and 30 km from Kumbakonam, in Tiruvarur district. Tiruvarur is the nearest town and rail head, with buses and taxis to the village.
